settings.title: Settings
settings.saveFailed: The setting could not be saved.
settings.languageHelp: System language follows your computer: German if it is set to German, English otherwise.

data.title: Data and sync
data.bundeslaenderHelp: The app loads the listings published for these Bundesländer.
data.autoSyncHelp: Checks the selected sources for new and changed listings every 6 hours while the app is open, and at start when the last check is older than that.
data.priceBasisHelp: Used for the price per m² of auctions. Insolvency sales always use the appraised value (Schätzwert).
data.retentionHelp: After that, the app deletes the files. You can enter 1 to 3650 days.
data.retentionInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 3650.

consent.title: Analysis consent
consent.given: You agreed on {{date}} that the app may send the text of appraisal reports (Gutachten) to your AI provider.
consent.givenNote: If you withdraw, the app asks again before the next analysis.
consent.notGiven: Before the first analysis, the app asks you to confirm that the text of the appraisal reports (Gutachten), owner names included, goes to the selected provider.

about.title: About Edikte
about.notAffiliated: Edikte is not affiliated with the Austrian Federal Ministry of Justice (Bundesministerium für Justiz).
about.source: The data comes from the public Ediktsdatei at edikte.justiz.gv.at and justizonline.gv.at.
about.personalUse: The app is meant for personal use.

providers.title: AI providers
providers.intro: Analyses run through the provider marked “In use”. Each provider works with your own account or API key.
providers.checkFailed: The last check of this provider failed.

description.chatgpt: Sign in with your ChatGPT account. Analyses count towards the usage limits of your plan.
description.claude-cli: Edikte runs the Claude CLI installed on this computer under your own account.
description.codex-cli: Edikte runs the Codex CLI installed on this computer under your own account.
description.openai-api: Uses your own OpenAI API key. OpenAI charges each analysis to the key's account.
description.anthropic-api: Uses your own Anthropic API key. Anthropic charges each analysis to the key's account.

source.known_location: Found in a usual install location

providers.noLongerUsed: {{provider}} is no longer used for analyses
providers.signingIn: Waiting for the sign-in in your browser…

oauth.connectHint: Opens the sign-in page in your browser.
oauth.identityOnly: You are signed in, but without access to models. Sign in again and allow model access.

cli.notInstalled: Not found. Install the CLI, then choose “Check again”, or choose its program file.
cli.updateRequired: This version lacks options Edikte needs. Update the CLI, then choose “Check again”.
cli.signInHint: Starts the CLI's own sign-in in your browser.
cli.staysSignedIn: The CLI itself stays signed in.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.help: The app checks the key with the provider and stores it encrypted on this computer. It is not shown again.
apiKey.tooShort: This is too short for an API key. Paste the whole key.
apiKey.removeText: The app deletes the stored key from this computer. To use {{vendor}} again, you need to enter the key again.

model.label: Model
model.loadFailed: The list of models could not be loaded.
model.none: The provider offers no models to choose from.
model.customHelp: For a model that is not in the list. The Codex CLI must accept the ID.
